title: cost --rework counts a content item's refused done and its resumed worker as rework, not only as research
goal: backlog.py cost --rework SP reports rework for a content item (touches under a kb root) whose landing's done was refused and whose worker was resumed to fix it, rather than folding all its figures under the research line where the work and rework split is not shown. In SP-6ukmjucf, ST-hojn6yjd's done was refused (done.refused outside-touches) and its worker resumed for 12 turns, yet cost printed 'no item has rework'.
notes: SP-6ukmjucf retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
